messages:
jordan_oncall: Alert — increased 5xx across AceraTech's dedicated eu-west-2 pool. Alert ID INC-3301 created by sre_bot. Observed 5xx rate ~12% over last 3m, client reports failing requests to /v1/generate. Paging oncall.

sre_bot: Incident INC-3301 created • runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-5xx • priority: P1 • assigned: jordan_oncall

kai_devops: I'm on it. Any recent deploys to that pool?

jordan_oncall: No deploys in past 2h. Autoscaler rolled a restart on one worker earlier. Logs show repeated OOMs on model-host-07 and connection resets.

ryan_engineer: Confirming: model-host-07 GPU memory errors, repeated restarts -> connection drops. I'm draining that host and reprovisioning a warm spare.

lexi_cs: Maria, AceraTech is on the line and wants outreach. Can you share the contact matrix and preferred outreach flow?

maria_account_manager: AceraTech contact matrix (TZs in parentheses):
- Pri: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@aceratech.com> (UTC+1) — phone +44 7700 900123 — prefer phone
- Sec: Priya Sen <priya@aceratech.com> (UTC+1) — phone +44 7700 900124 — prefer SMS then email
- Legal: compliance@aceratech.com — email only
Escalation order: Daniel -> Priya -> legal. If no ack within 10m escalate to VP_eng (cc).

sam_ops_manager: Routing rules: for enterprise customers use phone -> SMS -> email. Use escalation channel #enterprise-escalations for concise account-level blurbs. Also set dedicated slack tag #acct-acera for internal tracking.

jordan_oncall: Agreed. Drafting status page and customer blurb now.

jordan_oncall: Status page draft (post to incident status page and pennant):
```
We are investigating increased errors affecting AceraTech's dedicated inference cluster in eu-west-2 since ~09:12 UTC. Symptoms: elevated 5xx rates and increased latency for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Engineers are actively mitigating; we will provide updates every 10 minutes. For urgent account-level questions contact Daniel Hsu at daniel.hsu@aceratech.com or +44 7700 900123.
```

lexi_cs: Outbound customer email template (please personalize, send from account manager):
```
Subject: Redwood — Service disruption impacting AceraTech (eu-west-2)

Hi Daniel,

We're currently investigating an issue that is causing increased errors and timeouts for AceraTech's dedicated inference cluster in eu-west-2. Engineers are actively working on mitigation. Impact: some requests to generation and embedding endpoints may return 5xx or time out.

What we're doing: draining the affected host, reprovisioning capacity, and applying a temporary routing rule to route traffic away from affected hosts.

Next update: in 10 minutes or as soon as we have significant progress.

We apologize for the disruption. If you'd like a call now, reply or call +1-415-555-0100 and we'll connect you to the on-call engineer.

— Maria, Account Manager (maria_account_manager@redwood.com)
```

ryan_engineer: Implemented temporary routing rule: removed model-host-07 from pool and attached warm spare host. Monitoring latency and error rate.

jordan_oncall: Current metrics: 5xx down from ~12% -> ~4% after routing change, P95 latency improved ~30%. Continue to monitor for 30m stability window.

sam_ops_manager: Prepare message for enterprise exec channel and pre-baked credit estimate if this persists >30m. Suggest provisional credit: 25% usage credit for the impacted window (subject to review).

maria_account_manager: Ready to call Daniel and Priya now. Lexi will send initial email and follow up with a phone call. Use this tailored blurb for phone script:
"Hi Daniel, this is Maria from Redwood. We're investigating an incident impacting your eu-west-2 dedicated cluster causing some requests to fail. Engineers have rerouted traffic and we're seeing initial improvements; we're monitoring and will remain on the line. Expected fix window: unknown, will update every 10 minutes."

kai_devops: Adding note to runbook: mark model-host-07 as flaky and schedule deeper post-incident analysis (possible memory leak or model change).

jordan_oncall: On-call handoff note for next shift (copy into #oncall-handoff):
- Incident INC-3301
- Started: 09:12 UTC
- Current: routing workaround in place, 5xx ~4%, monitoring
- Actions taken: drained host, reprovisioned warm spare, temporary route rule applied
- Next steps: confirm stable for 30m, rollback route if stable, run diagnostics on host, capture heap/gpu metrics
- Contacts: maria_account_manager / +1-415-555-0100, lexi_cs, kai_devops
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-5xx

lexi_cs: Sending email and calling now :phone: — will log responses in CRM and update thread.

sre_bot: Update INC-3301 • status: mitigation in progress • severity: P1 • pageresolve ETA: unknown • next automated update scheduled in 10 minutes

jordan_oncall: Thanks team. If error rate climbs back above 8% we escalate to fleet rollback and open a customer bridge.

sam_ops_manager: Noted. Preparing post-incident tailored customer comm template and credit calc draft.

lexi_cs: Daniel answered — acknowledged, wants 15-min cadence updates. Priya is on standby. Recording ack in CRM.

jordan_oncall: Marking last update timestamp here. Continue monitoring; I'll hand off to @kai_devops at 09:50 UTC if stable.

sre_bot: Last automated note • INC-3301 • update logged at 09:19 UTC
